state_tokenization: Each document is tokenized independently and followed by the independently tokenized fixed double-newline delimiter before token-id concatenation. This constructively prevents BPE boundary changes when a new document is appended.
redesign_rationale: The frozen 38/69/92 sketch-state panel proved a reliable 3B latent gain but also a generic irrelevant-prefix effect and negative global interaction. This independent redesign does not tune that seed: it uses the proposition's alpha=1 width-linear law and complete retrieved documents so every registered state contains all selected multi-hop evidence before any seed-387803 model score.
reader_contract: The reader sees only the official prompt and question, never the answer or support labels. Deterministic BM25 seeds and exact title links produce one nested document order; complete documents are append-only across states.
dual_path_contract: The identical charged complete-document state feeds a compact evidence distribution and Qwen2 latent replay at the previously registered relative depth 0.875. A sample-clustered safe simplex includes exact Foundation and opens only for a positive paired 95% calibration LCB.

state_budget_rule.selection: B0=512 is a fixed power-of-two complete-state page; after constructive per-document tokenization, the final score-free seed-387803 audit verified that actual two/three/four-document states need at most 449/734/918 Qwen tokens, so no selected graph document is truncated.
state_budget_rule.charged_bytes: actual replay tokens * (2 * hidden_size bfloat16 bytes + 8 int64 token-id bytes)
state_budget_rule.relative_cost_gate: Both maximum-budget and observed actual co-scaled bytes per parameter, plus fixed-small-state bytes per parameter, must strictly decrease.

primary_estimand: paired per-example Foundation minus effective dual-path ASCENT answer NLL on 40 untouched test rows
factorial_estimand: Adjacent and global Foundation-by-state interactions from the complete 3x3 panel, each requiring a positive paired 95% LCB

controls.fixed: complete graph_small state on every Foundation
controls.memory_only_scaling: all three complete graph states on every Foundation
controls.query_only: co-scale-matched complete BM25 documents without graph expansion
controls.path_ablations: certified-only and latent-only NLL saved before fusion

development_success_rule.co_scaled_gain: Every diagonal safe gate opens and every endpoint NLL-gain LCB is positive.
development_success_rule.scale_complementarity: Both adjacent diagonal-gain LCBs and log-parameter slope LCB are positive.
development_success_rule.foundation_state_interaction: Both adjacent factorial-interaction LCBs and global interaction LCB are positive.
development_success_rule.fixed_control: Co-scaled beats complete Graph Small at 1.5B and 3B with positive LCBs.
development_success_rule.retrieval_controls: Graph beats query-only at 3B and irrelevant at every endpoint with positive LCBs.
development_success_rule.dual_path: A diagonal gate selects certified weight somewhere and latent weight somewhere.
development_success_rule.systems: All exact hash/commit/clean-tree/native/no-label/shared-state/prefix/cross-Foundation identity and decreasing-relative-state gates pass.

promotion_rule: Only development_pass=true authorizes official generation and three new confirmation seeds. Seed 387803 cannot be tuned into confirmation.
failure_rule: Any missed gate is retained as failure; later mechanisms require untouched data and may not reuse this panel for selection.
ceiling_policy: Continuous answer NLL is primary. Later accuracy will report absolute gain and frozen remaining-error elimination; perfect ASCENT is 100% error elimination, never a demand above 1.0.
